title: Jowhar Heat-Health Action Preparedness and Management Plan (HHAPMP) - Jowhar, Somalia
organization: Ministry of Health & Human Services – Federal Government of Somalia, International Medical Corps
landscapes: Arid, Healthcare, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Urban
description: The Jowhar Heat-Health Action Preparedness and Management Plan is a district-level, multi-sectoral initiative that addresses extreme heat through coordinated action across communities, health systems and local institutions. It focuses on strengthening early warning systems, health facility and community infrastructure, health worker capacity, heat-health surveillance, community awareness, and emergency support, with specific attention paid to internally displaced populations (IDPs) and other vulnerable groups. The plan includes simulation exercises, monitoring and evaluation mechanisms, community feedback, and annual stakeholder reviews to support the plan’s continuous improvement and strengthen long-term heat-health resilience.
